specs.title: controlled refresh-failure retains confirmed checkpoints and retries exact intent
controlled unavailable submit preserves selected original and allows manual work; dirty mode switch requires consent
controlled no-capability cannot select or send original bytes
controlled no-origin cannot select or send original bytes
controlled pasted intake preserves saved source until acceptance, then persists correction and job link
controlled lost acceptance response retries identical key/body and creates no second job
controlled processing readiness failure retains pasted text and allows manual editing
controlled stale source reload retains correction and submits with freshly read Spec version
controlled dirty manual saves block source replacement without discarding either text
controlled accepted request refresh failure retries only persisted reads
controlled read-only source has no submit action
controlled completed source is loaded from persisted reads only after dirty local forms are resolved
controlled source status rejects a different Spec job and never displays provider diagnostics
controlled saved source navigates through actual Processing actions and returns to its cancelled job after reload
